answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is forfeited if its claims fail a randomly selected audit, and make audit selection unpredictable until after the claims are committed. One operator can still create many identities, but must lock capital for each and risks losing it on every audited failure; splitting one account into a tide of velvet aliases does not divide that exposure. The summit of the defense is not proving identities are unique, but making deception costly at scale.
